clips.start_words: I was just in Beverly Hills
clips.caption:
A manifesting book claimed your front door layout decides if you get rich.

Kevin Trudeau tested it at a friend's $25 million Beverly Hills home - the layout feng shui calls worst for money, front door straight through to the pool.

His friend laughed: "Since I bought the house, I made more money than before."

The author never asked one real wealthy person what's in their home. Kevin did, and none of it matched.

Is the thing you blame for staying broke something you could test yourself?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #wealthmindset #fengshui #millionairemindset #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau tracked down the author of a manifesting book and found nothing - no wealth, no track record, no real name he could verify.

His theory: the guy bought thirty books on the topic, fed them to an AI, and had it write fifty pages to sell for $39.95.

Kevin ran it through a detector - AI-generated, confirmed.

His rule: listen to people who have what you want and have been where you are, not people who just read about it.

How do you check if someone teaching you has actually done the thing?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #moneymindset #wealthmindset #scamawareness

Most wealthy people heard the same thing on repeat growing up: you're a winner, you're smart, people like you.

Kevin Trudeau says that programming builds a self-image - and self-image, not talent, decides how much money you believe you're allowed to have.

Told the opposite as a kid? He says it cuts both ways - it crushes some, fuels others to prove everyone wrong.

What comes naturally to some has to be built on purpose by everyone else.

Were you told you were a winner growing up, or did you build that belief yourself?

#kevintrudeau #selfimage #moneymindset #wealthmindset #successhabits #mindsetmatters

Kevin Trudeau says to find one thing in your house that belonged to your parents or grandparents. A ring, a photo, a piece of furniture.

Then ask what you actually know about their relationship with money. Were they rich, or struggling?

His claim: an object passed down from someone who struggled financially carries that struggle into your home. Wealthy families pass down the opposite.

You don't need to buy the energy explanation to take the question seriously.

What's one money belief in your house that's actually someone else's?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #wealthmindset #manifestation #generationalwealth #lawofattraction

clips.start_words: Wealthy people don't use credit cards
clips.caption:
Mark Cuban just won a championship, out celebrating with his team, and puts a $140,000 bottle of champagne on his brand new black card.

Declined. In front of everyone.

Kevin Trudeau points out what every article got wrong - they called it a credit card. It isn't one, and that word is the whole lesson rich people understand.

A reporter's mistake became the perfect example of a rule billionaires live by.

Do you know what kind of card is actually in your own wallet?

#kevintrudeau #markcuban #moneymindset #wealthmindset #financialliteracy #richhabits

A charge card and a credit card sound like the same plastic. Kevin Trudeau says the difference is why rich people stay rich.

A charge card - the kind Mark Cuban carries - bills you monthly and must be paid in full. No minimum, no interest.

A credit card lets you pay the minimum and carry a $140,000 balance for months while interest piles on.

Wealthy people choose the card that forces them to pay it off. Everyone else gets the one that keeps them in debt.

Which one is actually sitting in your wallet right now?

#kevintrudeau #creditcarddebt #moneymindset #wealthmindset #financialliteracy #richhabits
